data.title: OpenAi shuts down robot unit second time in six years, but wants everyone to know that the company is committed to …
data.description: OpenAI has disbanded its standalone robotics team for the second time in six years, folding the group into its broader research and applied organisations. While the move echoes the company's decision to wind down its original robotics division in 2020, OpenAI insists the latest reorganisation is not a retreat from robotics but rather a sign of its commitment to bringing general-purpose robots into the world, according to a Fortune report.
